celebrationNote: Dark western win ladder BOUNTY..BOOT HILL. Hero plates generated on Layer AI (FLUX.1 [dev]); light/particle atlases from Kenney CC0 families plus pre-existing Scenario library renders (starburst, spark streak, spiked star, revolver, dust plume) that were downloaded only. Baked by tools/make_win_celebration_art.py. REPLACED celeb/celeb_t2..t7 (+ mp4 folders, celeb_whiteout) — Madam Mirror White Room asylum footage, deleted. celeb/win_frame carries NO thin outline: its baked gold inlay hairline, iron edge line, strap outlines and nail rims were removed because a 1-3px stroke baked at 1428px and drawn at ~563px minifies into a crisp bright line tracing the panel. The takeover's edge is the warm window spill plus the runtime god-rays and lantern bloom; tools/check_frame_edges.py fails the build if a stroke returns.
bonusEntryNote: Bonus-entry banner, TWO tiers matching the two real buy modes: DEAD MAN'S HAND (bonus_small 80x) and OPEN GRAVE (bonus_super 1000x), each a SINGLE enhanced spin. Hero plates generated on Layer AI (FLUX.1 [dev], same model and grade as the win tiers); bonus_frame_super adds Kenney CC0 fantasy-ui DOUBLE border/divider families over the same timber field. Baked by tools/make_bonus_entry_art.py, raw art fetched by tools/fetch_layer_bonus_entry.py. Contract: src/game/bonusEntryArt.ts. BOTH tiers reuse fx/win_celeb_light + fx/win_celeb_vfx, so there is no parallel bonus VFX set to regenerate. bonus_frame_small started as a copy of celeb/win_frame and is now its own file on purpose: the win takeover was asked to lose the thin outline tracing its panel (that inlay hairline is gone from win_frame and must not come back), while the banner was asked to keep its framing, so the banner owns the outlined build. tools/check_frame_edges.py asserts both expectations at real display size. This list is NOT the deleted free-spin/bonus-level art (mirror/intro_seance|otherside|bloodmoon, mirror/fs_intro*, mirror/fs_outro — THE INTAKE / HER SIDE / WHITEOUT): those stay deleted and unregistered.
